structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Vertical fabrication can reduce a manufacturability bottleneck, but fault tolerance and economic utility remain unresolved bottlenecks.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Platform breadth and manufacturing integration provide optionality, while useful quantum advantage remains technology- and workload-dependent.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Competing quantum modalities and classical/accelerated computing remain credible substitutes until workload-level advantage is established.

discovery-weak-signals.name: quantum manufacturing scale signal
discovery-weak-signals.basis: integrated chip fabrication and prototype operation move the roadmap toward repeatable semiconductor manufacturing

adversarial-red-team.name: thesisQuality
adversarial-red-team.basis: Commercial and manufacturing milestones strengthen the thesis while the hardest technical/economic gates remain unproven.

adversarial-red-team.name: financialOperatingMomentum
adversarial-red-team.basis: Revenue/RPO growth is strong but acquisition contribution complicates interpretation of organic execution.

expectations-execution.name: commercial execution
expectations-execution.basis: rapid revenue growth, higher guidance and expanding RPOs show commercial traction across the platform

items.risk: Prototype milestones and orders do not prove fault-tolerant performance, production yield or commercial unit economics at scale.

Manufacturing scale can improve while fault-tolerant performance or economic utility still fails to materialize.
